recognize_zh: 這不是形態圖，而是 14 張依住院日排列的紅血球體積直方圖：HD#3–4 峰的左側有小紅血球（碎裂紅血球）拖尾，HD#10 起右側出現明顯的大細胞「肩峰」（網狀紅血球），之後整個分布變寬，反映 TTP 溶血與骨髓代償的過程。
features: Series of 14 impedance RBC volume histograms labeled by hospital day (HD #3 to HD #18)
Early curves (HD #3-4) show a left-sided microcytic tail consistent with schistocytes
A right-sided macrocytic shoulder appears by about HD #5-7 and becomes prominent at HD #10-13
Later curves (HD #14-18) are broadened and right-shifted, reflecting increased RDW and MCV
Vertical solid and dotted gates mark the population percentile limits and 60/120 fL thresholds
describe_en: This figure shows serial impedance red cell volume histograms from a patient with TTP rather than a morphologic image. Early histograms show a single peak with a left-sided microcytic tail, consistent with circulating schistocytes and red cell fragments. From about hospital day 5 a right-sided macrocytic shoulder emerges and becomes prominent by day 10, reflecting reticulocytosis during recovery from hemolysis, and the distribution progressively broadens. These changes correspond to rising RDW and MCV and indicate that the histogram can track fragmentation and marrow response in TTP.
